subject: NOAA NBM live precipitation: overlapping accumulations double-counted
problem: scripts/fetch_noaa_precip.py used the first QPF band in each NBM GRIB file. Every 6 forecast hours the first band is QPF24 (a 24-hour total), which was added on top of the hourly QPF01 amounts covering the same hours, inflating rainy days several-fold. In 6-hourly files the first band was a 1-hour value, so days 2-11 never had full coverage and silently used the probability fallback.
example: Cycle 2026-11-06 04Z, Yale Farm, Connecticut day 2026-11-06: 208.6 mm reported vs 66.5 mm from non-overlapping hourly QPF (NWS OKX gridpoint forecast at 02:34Z: 36.7 mm).
fix: Read all QPF bands and chain non-overlapping intervals from the cycle time (hourly, then 6-hourly from the alignment point), shortest first. Coverage now reaches hour 260: direct NBM QPF for about 10 days.

correction.note: Its embedded correction_reason text is the script's older generic wording; this audit record states the actual reason.

not_affected: The sealed precipitation baseline ledger (PRISM 42-day mean) and all other ledgers. No NBM issue had been scored.
originals: All original NBM issue files are retained unchanged. Issues from 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 cannot be reissued (their days have started) and remain flagged here.
